sgp_meta.note: 0 game(s) on this card carry a rated leg and 3 carry a shoppable line row. ⛔ No combined chance is published for a same-game slip and no EV is either — the legs are correlated, so the product of their records would be a percentage asserting something false. sgp_rule: Same-game parlays from this card's own rows, ordered by each slip's WEAKEST leg — that leg's own record at its exact line. ⛔ No combined chance is shown and no EV is: the legs are in one game, so multiplying their records would assert they are independent when they are not. parlay_rule: Legs are in DIFFERENT GAMES and at the SAME BOOK. ⛔ Every number is the player's own record — nothing here is a model output, and the combined figure is those records multiplied, which assumes the games are unrelated.

college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in. College box scores list him only when he did something, so a game he played quietly can be missing — which nudges an over slightly high. That gap was measured against the NFL, where the true figure is known: a median of 0.2 percentage points and 3.8 at the 90th percentile. Short reception lines, where the gap is biggest, carry no record at all.
